title: New Beverage Showdown at BevNET Live LA 2026
summary: BevNET's non-alcoholic beverage pitch competition at BevNET Live LA (conference Dec 6-8, 2026; form lists the Showdown Dec 7-8, Marina del Rey). Apply by Oct 30, 2026, 5pm EDT; status emails week of Nov 2. Eligible: pre-launch or under 2 years on market, revenue <= $3M, funding <= $2M. Winner gets a $10K BevNET ad package; presenter must register and pay own travel.
why_relevant: Top beverage pitch stage judged by buyers, investors and brand execs; pre-launch brands qualify, so it fits a pre-seed beverage raise.

title: Natural Products Expo West 2027
source: Natural Products Expo West (New Hope / Informa)
summary: The largest natural and organic CPG trade show: Mar 2-5, 2027 at the Anaheim Convention Center (education from Mar 2, exhibit floor Mar 3-5). Attendee registration not yet open. Its Pitch Slam took applications through Jan 2, 2026 last cycle; the 2027 Pitch Slam call has not been announced.
why_relevant: Where national buyers, distributors and CPG investors gather; worth attending (or pitching) as the raise closes.

title: Nosh Pitch Slam at Nosh Live 2026
summary: Packaged-food pitch competition during Nosh Live, Dec 3-4, 2026 in Marina del Rey, CA. Only six brands pitch. Applications close Friday, Oct 16, 2026, 5pm EDT.
why_relevant: Investor- and buyer-facing pitch stage for early food brands; a beverage-only Sooz fits the New Beverage Showdown better.

title: ECRM Beverage Winter Session 2027
summary: ECRM's pre-scheduled buyer meetings for shelf-stable and refrigerated beverages, including functional and natural, Feb 15-17, 2027 at the Sheraton Grand Chicago. The Emerging Brands package includes 10-minute buyer appointments and the RangeMe Discovery Hub. Discounted rate $6,317 until Oct 16, 2026 ($6,650 full).
why_relevant: Direct meetings with retail beverage buyers across channels, but a big spend for a pre-seed brand.

title: Winter FancyFaire 2027 (formerly Winter Fancy Food Show)
summary: The Specialty Food Association's winter show, renamed Winter FancyFaire, follows its January 2026 San Diego debut with Jan 17-19, 2027 at Moscone Center, San Francisco (per the SFA announcement and event listings). Specialty retail and distributor buyers attend.
why_relevant: Major specialty food and beverage buyer show inside the 6-month window; good for retail and distributor discovery.

title: Future of Beverage 2026
summary: Beverage conference for retail and foodservice leaders: Nov 10-12, 2026 at the Renaissance Dallas Addison Hotel, with the first Bevvy Awards on Nov 11. Speakers include beverage leads from Smoothie King and Chili's. Registration is aimed at operators and retailers; check whether brands can attend or sponsor.
why_relevant: Texas-based beverage event with retail and foodservice beverage decision-makers, a short trip from Houston.
